directive: Replace the 80k-iteration `new Mesh(BoxGeometry)` loop with a single `THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, 80000)`; drive swarm motion per-instance via `setMatrixAt(i, matrix)` + `instanceMatrix.needsUpdate=true` each frame.
rationale: 80k separate Meshes = 80k draw calls; InstancedMesh renders all in one call, the only way swarm motion stays smooth at this count.

directive: Move the 60k-particle CPU drift loop onto the GPU: advance each point by its velocity attribute over uTime in a vertex shader (or GPUComputationRenderer position pass), wrapping on the radial/Y bounds. Drop the per-frame JS array rewrite.
rationale: 60k positions + per-particle sqrt rewritten on the main thread every frame is the sole bottleneck; geometry is already cheap.

directive: Replace CPU line-segment loop with GPU instancing: use InstancedMesh with cylinder geometry for edges, pass per-instance color via InstancedBufferAttribute, and encode start/end positions as instance attributes.
rationale: 60k vertices × edges on CPU LineSegments is expensive. Instanced cylinders with per-instance transforms/colors offload to GPU, enabling smoother growth and higher vertex counts.

directive: Move the 72k per-frame CPU position rebuild into the vertex shader: add a wheelIndex attribute and pass per-wheel center/T/B/angle as uniform arrays, compute each particle on-GPU. Frees the CPU to push particle count far denser.
rationale: 72k points are rebuilt on the CPU every frame; the wheel motion is fully deterministic, so it belongs in the vertex shader — unlocking a denser, richer cloud.

directive: Draw a single faint Line2 filament (LineMaterial, additive, low opacity) from the strayed bird to the flock centroid, lengthening during LOSS/SEEKING and pulling taut on RETURN. Makes the emotional arc spatially legible, not faked by point motion alone.
rationale: The narrative's core beat (separation→reunion) currently has no visible structure; a crisp tether line renders the arc directly.

directive: Swap each leaf's MeshStandardMaterial for the SubsurfaceScatteringShader (ShaderMaterial) from webgl_materials_subsurface_scattering, with thicknessColor warm-green and the existing side1 light as backlight, so thin leaves glow translucent instead of reading as opaque sheets.

directive: Replace the 400 thin-Line trace objects with one LineSegments2 + LineMaterial (fat lines), linewidth ~1.5–2px in world units. One draw call, crisp anti-aliased weighted filaments instead of 1px aliased GL lines that vanish at depth.

directive: Add EffectComposer + UnrealBloomPass (low strength ~0.4, high threshold ~0.85, small radius) after the main render so only the brightest resin edges bloom — turning the faked additive shimmer into genuine crisp luster, post-process so the 12k InstancedMesh path stays intact.
rationale: Faked shimmer plane becomes real specular glow on translucent resin edges; runs as post-process, so instancing and shader are untouched.

directive: Swap the trace-network THREE.Line/LineBasicMaterial pool for Line2 + LineGeometry + LineMaterial (fat lines). rationale: Trace network is half the composition but renders as invisible 1px hairlines; fat lines give it real, controllable width and spatial presence.

directive: Replace CPU point-cloud with GPU instancing (InstancedMesh) to unlock 10×+ density, enabling a denser starfield backdrop and richer atmospheric dust without frame drops.
rationale: 481 CPU points limits atmosphere density. GPU instancing trivially handles 5000+ motes, making the 'inhabited night' directive visually achievable.

directive: Build a THREE.CatmullRomCurve3 from the log-spiral, then scatter the 80k points on an expanding circular cross-section swept along it using the curve's Frenet/tangent frames (radius growing with theta) instead of the flat XZ heightOffset — turning chambers into a true volumetric shell horn.

directive: Swap the 400 individual one-pixel THREE.Line traces for a single LineSegments2 + LineMaterial (fat lines, width via worldUnits ~0.04). The trace network gains real, controllable, crisp weight instead of platform-clamped 1px hairlines, and collapses to one draw call.
rationale: LineBasicMaterial silently ignores linewidth on most GPUs, so the key trace mechanic renders as faint threads; fat lines make it legible structural network.

directive: Replace the per-block THREE.Line + LineBasicMaterial street grid with merged fat lines: push all block edges into one LineSegmentsGeometry rendered via LineSegments2 + LineMaterial (worldUnits, linewidth ~0.15, emissive amber/cyan). Crisp glowing streets, one draw call.
rationale: 1px LineBasicMaterial can't carry width or bloom; fat lines make the grid read as lit streets — the piece's core 'future city' signal — and collapse N draw calls to one.

directive: Add EffectComposer + UnrealBloomPass (threshold ~0.7, strength ~0.5, radius ~0.4) so the additive shimmer and inner-edge highlights bloom into real crisp glow, giving the frosted/resin surfaces lustrous specular bleed instead of flat palette color.
rationale: Instancing/shader path is already idiomatic; bloom is the cheapest single pass that turns faked translucency into genuine lustrous glow without touching the 12k GPU animation.

directive: Rebuild the trace pool with LineSegments2 + LineMaterial (Line2 fat-line system) so traces have real, controllable pixel width (e.g. 2-3px) instead of driver-clamped 1px hairlines; keep the accumulation mechanic and pooling intact, just swap the geometry/material class.

directive: Add scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x14131b, 0.012) keyed to the horizon ash tone so the flock and far starfield dissolve into real scene-space haze — genuine atmospheric scatter and depth the CSS gradient can only fake. Keep star material fog:false.

directive: Replace the trace network's thin LineBasicMaterial segments with Line2 + LineGeometry + LineMaterial from examples/jsm/lines, setting linewidth ~2–3px (worldUnits off) so traces read as crisp width-controlled industrial wiring instead of 1px GL hairlines.

directive: Replace LineBasicMaterial traces with Line2/LineMaterial (screen-space width) so the trace network reads as tangible connective structure, not invisible hairlines on HiDPI.

directive: Reuse a single BufferGeometry and MeshStandardMaterial for the ribbon; pre-allocate position/color attributes and set needsUpdate=true each frame instead of dispose-and-recreate.
rationale: Eliminates per-frame geometry/material alloc and GC thrash — the dominant perf cost here.

directive: Move leaf placement to GPU: store per-particle leaf-index + local offset as static attributes, pass 8 leaf positions as uniform vec3 array — eliminates 42k CPU writes per frame.
rationale: Only 8 leaves change per frame; CPU-looping 42k positions is unnecessary when instanced transforms suffice.

directive: Replace manual ping-pong FBO plumbing with GPUComputationRenderer — cuts ~50 lines of boilerplate and simplifies the confetti state-transition swap.
rationale: Already wraps exactly this pattern; fewer manual setRenderTarget/swap bugs during phase transitions.

directive: Pass eruption arm index and start-time as uniforms; compute all eruption displacement in the vertex shader using existing pathId attribute — eliminate CPU basePos lerping.
rationale: 85K CPU buffer updates per frame is wasteful; eruption is deterministic from (pathId, seed, uniforms) so belongs in shader.

directive: Move panel transforms to a mat4[12] uniform array; store panelIndex+UV as static attributes and compute positions in the vertex shader, eliminating the 40k CPU loop.
rationale: 12 rigid panels skinning 40k points is textbook GPU skinning — kills the per-frame CPU iteration entirely.

directive: Replace THREE.Points with InstancedMesh on a single-quad PlaneGeometry; sample GPGPU velocity in vertex shader to build per-instance rotation aligning each leaf along its Lorenz flow vector.
rationale: Points can't per-sprite rotate; InstancedMesh gives true oriented leaves at same GPU cost.

directive: Move pose lerp to GPU via morphAttributes on BufferGeometry — store posB as morphAttributes.position[0], drive morphTargetInfluences[0] with blend t, drop CPU loop.
rationale: Eliminates per-frame CPU lerp + upload of 70k×3 floats; GPU handles blend natively.

directive: Replace LineSegments with Line2/LineMaterial from addons for per-segment width control — silk strands should taper from anchor to hub, impossible with fixed-1px LineSegments.
rationale: LineSegments caps at 1px; Line2 gives world-unit width + taper per vertex for realistic silk.

directive: Move boomerang displacement to vertex shader: store home positions + radial dirs as static attributes, pass boomerang phase as uniform, compute arc in GLSL — eliminates 80K CPU position writes per frame.
rationale: 80K per-frame CPU writes bottleneck; vertex-shader animation is zero-copy and unlocks higher counts.

directive: Replace Line/LineBasicMaterial with Line2+LineMaterial (fat lines) for consistent screen-space string width and glow-friendly thickness on the light-string drape.
rationale: Native GL lines cap at 1px on most GPUs; fat lines give reliable width for the Gonzalez-Torres string aesthetic.

directive: Move bone endpoints into a uniform vec3 array (48 pairs); lerp position in vertex shader using existing pB/pTv as attributes, eliminating the per-frame CPU loop over 8640 particles.
rationale: CPU lerp per particle is unnecessary when bone data fits in uniforms; vertex shader does it for free.

directive: Replace THREE.Line with Line2/LineMaterial from lines/fat for per-vertex width and opacity, giving the light-strings real glow thickness without post-processing.
rationale: Gonzalez-Torres strings need soft width; default GL lines are 1px and cannot vary.

directive: Replace 1444 individual Mesh+Geometry+Material with a single InstancedMesh using one canonical leaf geometry, instanceColor for palette variation, and per-frame setMatrixAt for wave animation.
rationale: 1444 draw calls to 1; massive GPU/GC win for identical-topology leaves.

directive: Pre-allocate tube BufferGeometry once; update positions/normals in-place with needsUpdate each frame instead of dispose-and-recreate.
rationale: New geometry + GC every frame is the dominant cost; reusable buffers eliminate it.

directive: Move the 64×64 Stam solver to GPU ping-pong via WebGLRenderTarget + custom ShaderMaterial passes; sample velocity texture directly in the particle vertex shader.
rationale: CPU fluid sim caps at ~64²; GPU render-to-texture scales to 256²+ and lets particles read velocity in-shader.

directive: Move the 50k particle scatter from CPU attribute uploads to a vertex shader that reads the growth curve via a DataTexture updated once per growth step, eliminating per-frame BufferAttribute writes.
rationale: Curve has ~4k verts; encoding them in a small DataTexture lets the GPU scatter 50k points without CPU-side per-particle writes each frame.

directive: Replace the SVG feTurbulence CSS overlay with a single-quad ShaderMaterial using the same noise math — eliminates a composited full-screen SVG filter every frame for free.
rationale: SVG filter compositing is expensive and uncontrollable; a three.js fullscreen quad is cheaper and lets you animate the grain.

directive: Use InstancedMesh with InstancedBufferAttribute for per-leaf offset, rotation, opacity — update matrices via dummy Object3D only when breath phase changes, not every frame.
rationale: 10k ShapeGeometry leaves need instancing to avoid 10k draw calls; dynamic example shows per-frame attribute updates.

directive: Move boids flocking (spatial hash + 3 rules + velocity integration) to GPUComputationRenderer ping-pong textures; read positions back as texture for Points vertex shader.
rationale: CPU loop over 3200 boids with neighbor search each frame is the bottleneck; GPU flocking runs 10-50× faster at this count.

directive: Store analytical vein gradients in DataTexture GB channels; replace 3 texture fetches with 1 lookup plus analytical sine-wave derivatives for breathing terms.
rationale: Finite-diff gradient on 256² grid aliases with 120k particles; analytical gradients yield sharper caustic folds at 1/3 texture cost.

directive: Render the limning skeleton as Line2/LineMaterial fat lines over the particle cloud — L-system segments already exist, animate linewidth and gold color with uLimn for crisp calligraphic strokes instead of approximating outlines with scattered dots.
rationale: L-system segments map directly to fat lines; variable-width gold strokes read as manuscript limning far more crisply than point scatter.

directive: Upload polyline as DataTexture; move particle scatter to vertex shader via texture lookup, eliminating 50k×3 CPU position writes per frame.
rationale: Curve is ≤4000 verts — fits one small texture. Vertex shader samples it; CPU only updates the texture.

directive: Replace LineBasicMaterial with Line2/LineMaterial (fat lines) so threads can vary width — thicker when taut, hair-thin when healing — selling the snap-recoil physicality.
rationale: 1px hairlines can't convey tension; variable-width threads make snap/heal reads instantly.

directive: Replace LineBasicMaterial with Line2/LineMaterial from the fat-lines addon to render variable-width paint skeins — the particle.thick property is already computed but LineBasicMaterial ignores it.
rationale: LineBasicMaterial is always 1px; fat lines give per-vertex width, unlocking the viscosity physics already coded.

directive: Move boids (position+velocity) to GPUComputationRenderer with two float textures; the official webgl_gpgpu_birds example is this exact pattern and would let you push N to 10k+ for a denser murmuration.
rationale: CPU boids with spatial hash caps around 5k; GPU texture ping-pong removes that ceiling entirely.

directive: Move per-particle RK4 attractor integration to GPU via GPUComputationRenderer — encode thomas() in a GLSL compute texture, read positions back as a sampled attribute.
rationale: 50k × 4 RK4 evals × 3 sin() = 600k trig calls/frame on CPU; GPGPU makes this trivially parallel.

directive: Pack polyline into a DataTexture; sample curve position in vertex shader via seed attribute to eliminate the 50K-point CPU scatter and per-frame buffer upload.
rationale: CPU scatters 50K points every frame then uploads 3 buffers; GPU sampling removes that entirely.

directive: Pre-allocate tube BufferGeometry once; update position/color attributes in-place each frame via needsUpdate instead of dispose-and-recreate.
rationale: Avoids GC churn from 60 geometry allocs/sec; index buffer is static, only positions/colors change.

directive: If regrow runs at runtime, move gyroid rejection-sampling to GPUComputationRenderer to eliminate main-thread stalls; otherwise current Points+ShaderMaterial for 80k is idiomatic — no change needed.
rationale: CPU rejection loop (up to 1.6M trig calls) blocks frames; GPU texture feedback makes regrow instant.

directive: Move boids simulation to GPU via GPUComputationRenderer — the webgl_gpgpu_birds example is literally GPU Reynolds flocking with position/velocity textures, eliminating your CPU spatial-hash loop entirely.
rationale: CPU spatial-hash over 3200 boids each frame is the bottleneck; gpgpu_birds solves this exact problem on GPU.

directive: Merge all 3072 LineLoops into 2-3 LineSegments with a single dynamic BufferAttribute; update positions per frame via needsUpdate—collapses draw calls from ~3072 to ~3.
rationale: 1024 groups × 3 LineLoops = ~3072 draw calls; single-buffer LineSegments eliminates scene-graph overhead entirely.

directive: Replace PointsMaterial with a ShaderMaterial using gl_PointCoord disc falloff and a per-vertex size attribute so bloom petals render as soft circles distinct from dust.
rationale: 72K square points look harsh; disc alpha + per-particle size gives soft bloom for free.

directive: Replace the flat glow plane with UnrealBloomPass for the heartbeat pulse — real bloom from bright particles reads as luminous warmth, not a painted backdrop.
rationale: The plane fakes glow; selective bloom on the pendant particles makes the pulse physically convincing.

directive: Store both poses as attributes (posA, posB), pass morph t as uniform, lerp + disc-collapse in vertex shader — eliminates per-frame CPU buffer writes for 70k points.
rationale: GPU-side lerp removes 70k×3 CPU writes + needsUpdate each frame; trivial with existing ShaderMaterial.

directive: Move morph lerp to vertex shader: store posA/posB/posC as buffer attributes, pass morphT+phase as uniforms, lerp in shader — eliminates per-frame CPU loop and needsUpdate overhead for 70k points.
rationale: CPU-side 70k×3 lerp each frame is the bottleneck; GPU attribute lerp is free.

directive: Replace Points with InstancedBufferGeometry using a tiny leaf quad — removes gl_PointSize cap, gives true per-instance rotation and crisper leaf edges at all scales.
rationale: Point sprites cap at GPU max size; instanced quads give uncapped, geometrically sharp leaf fragments.

directive: Replace manual ping-pong render-target GPGPU with GPUComputationRenderer — eliminates blit pass, RT swap, and ortho-camera boilerplate while keeping identical GPU perf.
rationale: Manual ping-pong duplicates what GPUComputationRenderer already handles; cuts ~40 lines of plumbing.

directive: Replace Points+SDF with InstancedMesh of thin elongated quads oriented along velocity — true stroke aspect ratios without wasting fill on square point sprites.
rationale: Point sprites cap at square; instanced quads give real elongation for chalk strokes, cutting discarded fragments.

directive: Pre-allocate BufferGeometry with setDrawRange; update positions via needsUpdate instead of rebuilding tube geometry each growth step.
rationale: Eliminates per-frame geometry allocation and GC pressure as the growth expands.

directive: Write particle transforms directly into instanceMatrix.array as Float32Array — skip Object3D.updateMatrix() for all 55k instances each frame.
rationale: Bypassing 55k Object3D.updateMatrix() calls per frame eliminates the dominant CPU bottleneck.

directive: Encode the pre-computed path into a DataTexture and move phase-advance + lerp into the vertex shader, eliminating the per-frame CPU position buffer upload for 40k particles.
rationale: CPU uploads 480 KB/frame needlessly; path is static and GPU-sampleable.

directive: Merge tile triangles into InstancedMesh with per-instance color/phase attributes to halve vertex count and enable frustum-culled draw batching.
rationale: ~3k+ rhombus tiles each emitting 6 verts; instancing two quad templates drastically cuts geometry overhead.

directive: Merge all legs and cage bars into one BufferGeometry with drawRange, using webgl_lines_fat for width-varied threads instead of LineBasicMaterial.
rationale: Collapses ~22 draw calls to 2–3; fat lines give thread thickness control LineBasicMaterial lacks.

directive: Use Line2/LineMaterial (fat lines) for trails — per-vertex linewidth maps boid speed to chalk pressure, giving Twombly-grade gestural thickness variation that GL_LINES cannot.
rationale: GL_LINES are always 1px; Line2 gives variable-width strokes essential for chalk-pressure gesture.

directive: Replace thin THREE.Line trails with Line2/LineMaterial (fat lines) for width-varying Twombly chalk strokes — set linewidth by windStr per segment for pressure-sensitive scribble.
rationale: 1px hairline trails undercut the chalk-stroke intent; fat lines give variable-width arcs natively on GPU.

directive: Move arc-position math into vertex shader analytically (center + R·cos/sin); pass tileType, arcIdx, phase as per-particle attributes — eliminates 36k CPU loop and per-frame buffer upload.
rationale: Arc formula is pure trig; GPU-side computation removes the only per-frame CPU bottleneck.

directive: Pipe AudioAnalyser frequency data into a uniform to drive breath/offset amplitude — the piece claims audio-reactive but has zero audio input.
rationale: Direction says audio-reactive; code has none. AudioAnalyser is the idiomatic three.js bridge.

directive: Encode 4 curve Y-arrays into a DataTexture, move distribute() into the vertex shader to eliminate the 40K-iteration CPU loop each frame.
rationale: CPU binary-search per particle per frame is the bottleneck; GPU lookup via texture is O(1) and frees the main thread.

directive: Pre-allocate BufferGeometry at MAX size; update position/normal arrays in-place via needsUpdate=true instead of dispose-and-recreate each frame — eliminates per-frame GC churn.
rationale: Per-frame geometry alloc/dispose causes GC stalls; in-place buffer updates are the idiomatic three.js path.

directive: Replace LineBasicMaterial vessel lines with Line2/LineMaterial for variable-width vascular tubes that taper from surface to core, selling the organic vessel form before detonation.
rationale: LineBasicMaterial is 1px constant; LineMaterial supports worldUnits width + per-vertex linewidth for organic taper.

directive: Move Gray-Scott RD to GPUComputationRenderer — run the diffusion as a ping-pong fragment shader, sample the texture in the vertex shader for displacement/color.
rationale: CPU double-loop over 128×64 grid caps iterations/frame; GPU compute unlocks higher-res grids and more steps for finer coral detail.

directive: Use InstancedMesh + MeshPhysicalMaterial with iridescence, iridescenceIOR, and transmission for the 120 bubbles instead of a custom bubble shader — gives physically-based thin-film rainbow shifts for free.
rationale: 120 bubbles are few but iridescence via MeshPhysicalMaterial is cheaper and more accurate than hand-rolled thin-film in a fragment shader.

directive: Remove the 6 manually-duplicated back-face vertices from leafGeo — side:DoubleSide already flips normals, so you're doubling per-instance vertex count (12→6) for nothing.
rationale: DoubleSide handles back-face shading; redundant verts double vertex throughput across ~20k instances.

directive: Render gyroid via fullscreen raymarched SDF quad (ShaderMaterial + PlaneGeometry already in scene) instead of point-cloud approximation — gives pixel-perfect isosurface at zero particle cost.
rationale: Gyroid SDF is analytically cheap; raymarching it directly eliminates point-density aliasing and sharpness issues.

directive: Sample a petal-shaped alpha sprite texture in the fragment shader, lerping from round falloff to petal shape by effectiveVolley, so detached motes read as actual petals not round dots.
rationale: Creative constraint says 'leaf-as-petal' but all particles are identical round discs — a texture swap during flight would realize the constraint visually.

directive: Replace per-crystal Mesh array with a single InstancedMesh; update matrices via setMatrixAt each frame for stuck/calving/drifting states.
rationale: 900 identical geometries = 900 draw calls; InstancedMesh collapses to 1.

directive: Replace per-frame ribbon BufferGeometry rebuild with a single preallocated geometry using setAttribute once, then update positions via array.set + needsUpdate each frame.
rationale: Avoids GC pressure from recreating geometry every frame; same pattern as the interactive buffergeometry example.
